svg.text: Home ground: the Dhaka brick-kiln belt
Kilns counted from a published Sentinel-2 map. NASA's fire product finds them no more often than empty ground.
717 mapped kilns. Orange: FIRMS also saw a VIIRS hotspot. Blue: it did not. Diamonds: FIRMS persistent heat sources.
